verdict.rationale: Docusign exposes a full REST API, SDKs (e.g. Node client), and OpenAPI specifications that allow programmatic, non-interactive use of send/sign/manage workflows, and community reports confirm production automation built entirely via the API (embedded signing services, Postman POCs). However there is no explicit documentation of CI/CD usage, headless/service-account patterns, or automation-specific guidance, and one community report describes API friction/breakage in automated embedded flows. Missing for 10: explicit CI/headless automation docs, service-account/non-interactive auth guidance, and independent confirmation of stable CI pipeline use.
